integrity: The proof uses an exact annealed path product and source regeneration series. Rational enumeration corroborates the first two odd-moment regimes. Independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to one-dimensional spatially iid whole-field regeneration with balanced mean and to speed as the refresh probability approaches one; no global sign claim away from one; finite code is corroboration only; historical priority is not independently audited.
title: Odd-moment detection and direction reversal in rapidly regenerated random environments
